learnerSourceCheck.prompt: Locate the source fraction 6/4 on a number line; what fraction is it?

supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s locate non-unit fractions on the number line.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Locate non-unit fractions on the number line (including fractions greater than 1).
teachingSteps: Choose the whole interval from zero to one.
Partition it into equal intervals according to the denominator.
Count intervals from zero to locate and name the numerator position.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Intervals must be equal; tick count is not the same as interval count from zero.
